_note: PLACEHOLDER — the v0 itemization spine. Two curios drop unidentified and identify at the Storehouse: one into a consumable, one into a key. The key opens a locked cache in a DIFFERENT world than the one it dropped in (design-brief-v0, delayed-payoff seed). GEAR: a standard assortment across eight slots (Aimee, 6 Aug), each running common -> uncommon -> rare -> mythic, and every piece upgradeable at the Blacksmith. Weapons cover all three corners of the damage triangle at every quality, so the matchup against a creature's covering is always answerable with something you could plausibly be carrying. PLACEHOLDER names, blurbs and tiers. INSULATION AND REACTIVITY on gear are Q36's addition (audit #9): the other four material properties each decide what the Blacksmith asks for, and these two decided nothing, so a warm pelt and a volatile ichor were worth nothing to wear. Insulation on anything protective turns aside a heat emanation; reactivity on a weapon leaves something in the wound. Authored here because found gear is a catalogue entry — crafting doesn't exist yet, and when it does these become the crafted piece's own material properties. PLACEHOLDER values. 7 Aug: EIGHT WILD-ONLY WEAPONS (apex-encounters.md §4). Each breaks exactly one rule a crafted piece cannot break, and each is deliberately MID-TIER: you are buying the rule, not the numbers, so a two-natured blade at tier 3 is a real trade against a superb crafted one. They drop guaranteed from an apex and vanishingly rarely from anything else. ALL TIERS PLACEHOLDER.

items.name: Essence Crystal
items.blurb: Essence held in a stable quartz lattice. Auber records what made it possible.

items.name: Heat Core
items.blurb: A provenanced concentration of heat, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Caustic Core
items.blurb: A provenanced caustic concentration, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Light Core
items.blurb: A provenanced concentration of light, prepared for a Channelworks housing.

items.name: Heat Conduit Fixture
items.blurb: Oda's first contained Conduit housing, carrying the receipt of the core inside it.

items.name: Humming Shard
items.blurb: It hums when you are not listening.

items.name: Bound Knot
items.blurb: Tied by someone who meant it to stay tied.

items.name: Lesser Salve
items.blurb: Restores a little health to one party member.

items.name: Salve
items.blurb: Restores a useful measure of health to one party member.

items.name: Greater Salve
items.blurb: Enough medicine to turn a grave injury into a survivable one.

items.name: Draught of Clearing
items.blurb: Clears poison and closes a bleeding wound.

items.name: Quenching Draught
items.blurb: Quenches burning and clears the eyes after a dazzling emanation.

items.name: Broad Antidote
items.blurb: Draws out one affliction, whatever shape it took.

items.name: Stonebark Tonic
items.blurb: Turns aside the next affliction that would take hold.

items.name: Venom
items.blurb: Coats one weapon so its next strike leaves poison behind.

items.name: Firebrand
items.blurb: Coats one weapon so its next strike keeps burning.

items.name: Briar Oil
items.blurb: Coats one weapon so its next strike leaves a stubborn wound.

items.name: Flashsalt
items.blurb: Coats one weapon so its next strike dazzles its target.

items.name: Solvent
items.blurb: Reveals one unidentified curio while still in the field.

items.name: Lure
items.blurb: Wakes the nearest roaming creature and draws it toward you.

items.name: Stillwater
items.blurb: Coaxes a failing world into holding together a little longer.

items.name: Waystone
items.blurb: Forces a way home immediately, carrying the whole haul with you.

items.name: Torch
items.blurb: Pushes the dark back for the rest of this journey.

items.name: Farsight Draught
items.blurb: Reveals the nearest site and a little of the country around it.

items.name: Cache Key
items.blurb: Fits a lock in a world that is not this one.

items.name: Anchor Frame
items.blurb: A carried binding strong enough to fasten one world back into the Atlas.

items.name: Chipped Blade
items.blurb: Somebody's, once. It still holds an edge on one side.

items.name: Keen Blade
items.blurb: Balanced, and cared for. Whoever left it did not mean to.

items.name: Ripping Hook
items.blurb: It was made to open things that did not want opening.

items.name: The Long Grievance
items.blurb: Nobody agrees on what it was first used for.

items.name: Bone Awl
items.blurb: Ground to a point against something harder.

items.name: Raking Edge
items.blurb: Notched all along one side, and the notches are the point.

items.name: Binder's Edge
items.blurb: Marked along the spine in a hand you almost recognise.

items.name: Hairsplitter
items.blurb: It has never once been resharpened.

items.name: Field Maul
items.blurb: A weight on a handle. It asks nothing of you.

items.name: Banded Mace
items.blurb: Ringed against the shock of its own work.

items.name: Anvilfall
items.blurb: Two hands, and a moment's warning.

items.name: The Settled Argument
items.blurb: Heavier than it looks, and it looks heavy.

items.name: Long Pick
items.blurb: Reach, at the cost of everything else.

items.name: Warded Spear
items.blurb: Keeps the thing you are fighting where it is.

items.name: Parting Needle
items.blurb: Goes in where there is no gap, and makes one.

items.name: The Kept Distance
items.blurb: Whoever carried this was never touched.

items.name: Split Board
items.blurb: Held together by habit.

items.name: Banded Buckler
items.blurb: Small, quick, and enough.

items.name: Tower Guard
items.blurb: You can put the whole world behind it.

items.name: The Unarguable
items.blurb: Nothing has got past it yet.

items.name: Padded Cap
items.blurb: Better than the alternative.

items.name: Ridged Helm
items.blurb: Turns a blow rather than taking it.

items.name: Visored Casque
items.blurb: You see less, and you keep seeing.

items.name: Crown of Quiet
items.blurb: It muffles more than sound.

items.name: Padded Guard
items.blurb: Layered cloth and patience. Better than nothing, which is what you had.

items.name: Banded Guard
items.blurb: Someone spent a winter on this.

items.name: Vaultplate
items.blurb: Cold to the touch, and stays cold.

items.name: The Standing Wall
items.blurb: It has outlived several people who deserved better.

items.name: Wrapped Hands
items.blurb: Cloth, and knots you tied yourself.

items.name: Studded Gloves
items.blurb: For holding things that object.

items.name: Gauntlets of Hold
items.blurb: Your grip is no longer the weak part.

items.name: The Sure Hands
items.blurb: They do not shake. You still might.

items.name: Worn Boots
items.blurb: They have been further than you have.

items.name: Shod Boots
items.blurb: Iron at the toe, for ground that bites.

items.name: Longstriders
items.blurb: The map got smaller when you put them on.

items.name: The Unhurried
items.blurb: You arrive when you meant to.

items.name: Bent Pick
items.blurb: It works. That is the whole of its case.

items.name: Balanced Pick
items.blurb: Swings where you meant it to.

items.name: Corebreaker
items.blurb: Hard ground stopped being an argument.

items.name: The Willing Edge
items.blurb: It seems to know what you were about to do.

items.name: Pressed Leaf
items.blurb: From somewhere. You remember which.

items.name: Cold Compass
items.blurb: It does not point north. It points somewhere.

items.name: Someone's Ring
items.blurb: Too small for you. You keep it anyway.

items.name: The First Page
items.blurb: Torn out, and kept, and never read aloud.

items.name: Two-Natured Blade
items.blurb: One edge bites and the other tears. Nothing you could forge is two things at once.

items.name: Long Fang
items.blurb: A tooth as long as your forearm, hafted short. It should not reach as far as it does.

items.name: Ranked Spear
items.blurb: It goes through, and keeps going. Whoever was standing behind finds that out.

items.name: Barbed Edge
items.blurb: Its backward thorns stay in the wound. Nothing needs to be spread on them first.

items.name: Living Hook
items.blurb: It is sharper than it was last week. You have not sharpened it.

items.name: Quiet Knife
items.blurb: It makes no sound going in and none coming out. Nothing notices you using it.

items.name: Bloodletter
items.blurb: What it opens does not close. Not on its own, and not in time.

items.name: Warded Haft
items.blurb: Something is written down the shaft in a hand older than yours. Crush blows slide off it.
